test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: "A thorn in the flesh"

options.text: A close friend who offers advice
A constant source of irritation or trouble

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. A constant source of irritation or trouble. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"A thorn in the flesh"** means a persistent cause of annoyance or trouble. (कांटे की तरह चुभने वाला या परेशानी का कारण) • **Example:** The noisy neighbors have become a thorn in the flesh for the entire apartment building. • It refers to someone or something that continuously irritates or causes difficulties. (लगातार परेशान करने वाला कारण) • **Example:** The new policies were a thorn in the flesh for the employees as they made work harder. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: A close friend who offers advice** (सलाह देने वाला करीबी दोस्त) - This does not match the meaning of the idiom. • **Example:** He is more than a friend; he’s always there to guide me through tough times. • **Option 3: A long-forgotten mistake** (लंबे समय से भूली हुई गलती) - This is unrelated to the idiom's meaning. • **Example:** The mistake he made in his early career is now just a long-forgotten memory. • **Option 4: A painful injury** (एक दर्दनाक चोट) - While it may sound literal, it does not represent the idiom's figurative meaning. • **Example:** The athlete overcame his painful injury to win the championship. 32:Ta9f, The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Waste time on lost cause.
